verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Ramp exposes its own official MCP server (ramp-probe-2) for others to connect to, but there is no evidence Ramp itself can act as an MCP client and plug in external MCP servers to extend its AI agents' toolset. Missing for 10: any documentation of Ramp's AI agents consuming external MCP servers, any client-side MCP configuration UI, or user guides for adding third-party MCP tool providers.
